title: Sentinel Evaluation Protocol Manifest
author: Luis Merida <tatomerida21@gmail.com>

corpus_development.notes: Historical benchmark corpus (July 2026). Strictly treated as development/regression, never as external holdout.

rules: All contrastive pairs and paraphrased derivatives sharing family_id or parent_id must be assigned to the exact same split.
The test split must remain strictly sealed and is forbidden from prompt tuning, threshold optimization, or feature selection.
No case from the historical 353 development dataset may be reclassified as external holdout.

recall_at_zero_false_blocks.definition: Recall of RISK conversations at the minimum action threshold where false positive block rate on BENIGN conversations is strictly 0.

expected_calibration_error.definition: Weighted absolute difference between empirical accuracy and mean confidence across 10 equal bins: [0, 0.1), [0.1, 0.2), ..., [0.9, 1.0].

paired_bootstrap_comparison.definition: Family-level grouped bootstrap with 1,000 iterations to evaluate candidate vs baseline delta.
paired_bootstrap_comparison.conclusive_rule: Delta 95% confidence interval must exclude zero ([ci_lower, ci_upper] > 0).

pre_registered_gates.G0: Reproducibility: Deterministic local commands, frozen fixtures, zero production credentials.
pre_registered_gates.G1: Validity: Full data provenance, zero cross-split family leakage, sealed holdout test set.
pre_registered_gates.G2: Shadow Entry: Decision contract, timeouts, and fallbacks tested; 0 impact on production decisions or defaults.
pre_registered_gates.G3: Candidate Supervised Promotion: +10 pts recall over baseline, <= +2 pts benign review rate, 0 false blocks, paired bootstrap CI strictly > 0.
pre_registered_gates.G4: Authorized Pilot: Tenant isolation, data retention compliance, human operator oversight, rollback ready.
pre_registered_gates.G5: Autonomous Actions: Out of scope for this cycle. Requires external validation with protection authorities.

methodological_disclaimers: Accuracy on synthetic contrastive pairs evaluates model consistency and cultural nuance, but does NOT represent real-world population prevalence.
No external holdout is currently available; results on internal holdouts represent upper-bound estimates.
Human review cannot be simulated by LLM agents without explicit expert adjudication.
